divisions.title: Jerusalem Destroyed
divisions.theme: The city mourns under God's judgment
divisions.summary: Jerusalem personified weeps over her desolation. God's anger described in vivid detail as elders sit silent in the dust.

divisions.title: Hope in the Ruins
divisions.theme: His mercies are new every morning
divisions.summary: The man who has seen affliction finds hope in God's steadfast love and faithfulness.

divisions.title: Jerusalem's Lament
divisions.summary: Precious sons of Zion now valued as clay pots. A final plea asking God to remember and restore his people.

2.title: Lord has swallowed up without mercy

3.title: I am the man who has seen affliction
His mercies never come to an end
Let us test and examine our ways
I called on your name O Lord

4.title: Lord gave full vent to his wrath
Our pursuers were swifter than eagles

5.title: Remember O Lord what has befallen us
But you O Lord reign forever
